review_type: independent fixed-revision diff/reference review, native capture inspection and focused test reruns
verdict: Run 19 fixes the main per-MAV DATA guided-state ownership problem and provides an executing scrollbar-drag regression. Exact software parity remains incomplete. The advertised native final-column capture is blank, and the shared guided cache still does not cover the original message forms and guards. No 10/10.

scores.scale: Qualitative exact-original software parity scores, not completion percentages. Overall equally weights UI/UX and features. Prior reports provide gap context, not fresh proof of every earlier claim.

rationale: DATA now reads the selected link's per-system/component shared target. Valid altitude edits update that target without replacing its coordinates, and the map marker follows the selected MAV only while Guided. Production-link and egui keyboard tests support those changes. The Status drag test passes at two small sizes, and the normal native capture shows the reserved bottom scrollbar. However, the MP_STATUS_END capture contains no Status text at all. Its f32::MAX offset is not acceptable visual evidence of the final column. The raw-command observer also supports fewer message variants than the original and omits its mission-type guard. Missing CurrentState values, video pipelines, plugin execution, localization and native transports/mobile behavior remain material barriers to an honest 10.

inspected: git diff HEAD^..HEAD at fixed HEAD, including README, flight_data.rs, link.rs, altitude_change.rs, link_sim.rs and capture_round.ps1
reference/MissionPlanner/GCSViews/FlightData.cs guided altitude, Fly To Here and marker callers
reference/MissionPlanner/ExtLibs/ArduPilot/Mavlink/MAVLinkInterface.cs setGuidedModeWP, setPositionTargetGlobalInt and observed mission/position cache updates
Selected unchanged broad-gap implementations in state.rs, hotkey_tools.rs, views/config.rs, views/flight_data.rs, comms.rs and platform.rs

capture_integrity.receipt_scope: Both manifests match the independently hashed binary and report native eframe viewport captures at 1280x800 with a connected simulator and completed parameter download. The second image's blank panel means the receipt does not establish visible final-column rendering. MP_STATUS_END is a developer offset override, not a replay of desktop mouse input.

reviewer_executed_verification: git rev-parse HEAD matched the requested fixed revision; initial git status was clean.

cargo test -p mp-app guided_tests -- --nocapture passed all 3 tests, including actual egui pointer events dragging the Status scrollbar at 300x400 and 260x220 and keyboard save/reject/cancel through the altitude dialog.

cargo test -p mp-core --test altitude_change -- --nocapture passed all 6 tests, including raw position target addressing, three MAV selections, a second connection, and frame 0/3/10 wire output for Plane and Copter.
Viewed both native screenshots with view_image and compared manifest SHA256 values with Get-FileHash.
Compared the changed Rust behavior with the original C# callers and guided-cache message branches.
author_reported_verification: Parent reports 137 workspace tests passing in a full rerun. One earlier tlog_logs_and_playback wait_event timeout passed in isolation and a full rerun; root cause remains unknown.
The final MP_STATUS_END capture flag was added after the reported full suite. The parent reran the three guided tests and built the binary.
verification_limits: This reviewer ran the focused 9 tests, not the full workspace suite. The reported intermittent tlog timeout is unresolved evidence, not an established fixed defect.
The original C# application was not launched for equal-state native pixel or interaction comparison.
The drag regression drives real egui events in a test context. No desktop scrollbar drag was replayed against the actual DATA window.
The final-column native image is blank. It cannot be counted as successful final-column verification.
No native multi-MAV DATA marker switching, HTTP-to-DATA interaction or separate-connection switching was driven through the desktop window in this review.
No exhaustive review of earlier pages, swarm algorithms or every CurrentState decoder was repeated.
Native mobile packages, device runs and non-Windows execution were not verified. Physical flight/camera/radio qualification is separate from this software score.
scope.reviewer_actions: Read-only source/capture inspection and focused test execution; authored judging/round-19.json only. No implementation edits, commits, push or subagents.

run19_dispositions.closed_parts: Removed the view-global guided altitude, frame and marker target. The selected link and sysid/compid key now supply DATA state. Altitude dialog updates preserve that MAV's coordinates. Fly To Here reuses its altitude/frame, and the map marker is drawn only for the selected Guided MAV with a nonzero latitude. Tested vehicle selection and separate connection state stay independent.
run19_dispositions.remaining: Closure is for the ownership defect identified in round 18. It does not claim complete original MAVLink cache/message parity or native multi-MAV interaction verification.

run19_dispositions.closed_parts: Worker send observes full-position SET_POSITION_TARGET_GLOBAL_INT and current=2 MISSION_ITEM_INT messages using their addressed system/component, including a nonselected MAV. The raw-position test and Plane/Copter guided wire tests pass.
run19_dispositions.remaining: note_guided_command omits legacy MISSION_ITEM current=2; the original handles both mission forms. It accepts MISSION_ITEM_INT current=2 without checking mission_type==MISSION, unlike the original. Its position mask filter also differs from the original observed SET_POSITION_TARGET_GLOBAL_INT branch, which has no such filter. Add explicit supported-message semantics and fixtures before claiming complete raw-command parity.

run19_dispositions.closed_parts: Content height now reserves room inside the panel. The normal native capture visibly has a bottom scrollbar, and the passing test presses and drags it to the end using pointer events at two small panel sizes.
run19_dispositions.remaining: The final-column capture is blank because the developer path supplies f32::MAX before content painting. Large floating-point translation loses the intended layout precision. Replace it with a finite computed maximum, then inspect final labels. A developer offset capture still does not replace an actual desktop drag.

remaining_software_gaps.area: Complete CurrentState values and numeric choosers
remaining_software_gaps.next_fix: Port missing decoders, defaults and derived values in coherent groups. Compare outputs and chooser membership with original C# fixtures; registered names and explicit nulls do not provide the missing behavior.

remaining_software_gaps.area: Complete guided message semantics and native proof
remaining_software_gaps.next_fix: Cover MISSION_ITEM, mission-type guards and partial position masks against the original, including addressed nonselected MAVs. Then drive HTTP/script target changes, altitude edits and MAV/connection switches through DATA and verify selected marker/altitude/frame.
Replace f32::MAX with a finite content-width minus viewport-width offset and recapture visible final labels. Record a native desktop drag to the last column at normal and small window sizes.
Implement actual GStreamer discovery and source pipelines plus HereLink and payload/gimbal video flows. Verify deterministic video through the visible controls.
Implement original plugin lifecycle and callback/page capability through a compatibility host. Listing plugin files with disabled checkboxes is incomplete.
Apply translated resources and persisted culture and compare the original language selection behavior beyond English.
Implement BLE/WinUSB/custom transport capability and mobile file/USB serial adapters, build native packages and verify their software flows on target devices.

ten_out_of_ten_criterion: An honest 10 requires no known material software discrepancy in the promised exact-clone scope and adequate source, decoder, interaction and native-platform verification. This targeted improvement leaves concrete missing behavior, so a 10 is not supportable.
